ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Linux Process Code Injection Via DD Utility
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the injection of code by overwriting the memory map of a Linux process using the "dd" Linux command.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/dd$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*of\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/proc\\/.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/mem.*")))
